hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.html ]]; then echo '--- auto node --check on edited HTML ---'; python3 -c "import re; c=open('$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH').read(); [print(m.group(0)[:50]) for m in re.finditer(r'<script(?![^>]*src)[^>]*>', c)]" | wc -l; fi
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=d.get('command',''); import re; exit(2 if re.search(r'git push.*master', cmd) else 0)"
